Layer1Ptrs.name: Pointer table: level layer 1 data
summary: 3-byte pointers (16-bit address, bank) to each level's layer 1 object data, indexed by level number * 3 ($600 bytes, 512 entries).
Index = level number from the overworld ([$0E]; $25+ is reduced by $24) plus $100 when on a submap. Layer2Ptrs at $05:E600 is the parallel table for layer 2.
Most entries point to $06:8000, a shared default (blank) level used by unused level numbers. Read by the level loader at $05:D8C2.
